title: Borrowed shadow
description: A vermilion interlocked cutout hovers over ivory paper; its projected shadow follows the geometry and softens with distance.
useCase: Give a sculptural graphic a tangible relationship to its surface in a product, identity or editorial study.
interaction: Drag the suspended cutout. Arrow keys move it; Home returns it to its starting position.
reducedMotion: There is no autonomous movement or easing. Direct drag and keyboard changes redraw immediately.
limitations: A planar original silhouette projected onto one receiver, using bounded area-light samples; not arbitrary mesh shadow mapping or a physically calibrated lighting simulator. Requires WebGL 1; controls disable with an explicit fallback and recover after context restoration.
look: A lacquer-red interlocked crescent sculpture suspended by a fine wire on warm ivory, with a broad charcoal projected shadow and restrained edge highlights.
motion: Moving the visible cutout changes the plane intersection of rays from a fixed area source. Light size and suspension height change the penumbra; light azimuth changes its direction. The renderer is idle between changes.
adapt: Use `DEFAULT_CONFIG` and the `config` prop to set light size, blocker height and azimuth. `shape` defines the original silhouette; `position` is direct-manipulation state. `useSurface` owns WebGL allocation, context restoration and demand rendering.
